description: Desktop app for terminals and coding agents that keeps work in spaces, shows which agents need attention, and leaves terminals running when the window closes
notes: Herdr needs a herdr-core to run terminals: the app installs one into %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\herdr-core when it finds none, adds that folder to your user PATH, and updates it from then on. Scoop uninstall removes none of that.

App settings, mods and layouts live in %USERPROFILE%\.config\herdr-app, and the core keeps state in %LOCALAPPDATA%\herdr-core and settings in %APPDATA%\herdr-core. Scoop uninstall removes none of these.
